fact_check_log.claim: Intro: Europe in summer; Fiji, Mauritius, NZ cooler months; Bali outside usual wet season
Takeaway: August rain slight on paper at Greek islands and Riviera
Takeaway: 15 August public holiday in Italy
Takeaway: Fiji and NZ August 2026 varied by coast and region (dated 2026)
WMO pages: averaging periods and rain-day definitions differ between countries
Naxos (HNMS, period not published): Aug mean 25.0 C, mean max 27.0 C
Naxos: Aug rainfall 1.6 mm over 0.3 days
15 August, Assumption, public holiday set by law (linked at claim)
Milan 1971 to 2000: min 17.6 C, max 28.5 C, 88.8 mm; Milan is a city station, not lakeside
Naples 1971 to 2000: min 19.1 C, max 30.3 C, 35.5 mm, about 3 rain days; not on the Amalfi Coast
Nice 1971 to 2000: min 20.0 C, max 27.2 C, 23.9 mm over 2.9 days >=1 mm; Nice station, not wider coast or Provence
Summer 2026 hottest in France since 1900; heatwave 28 July to 19 August 2026 (labelled one summer)
Lisbon 1961 to 1990: min 17.7 C, max 27.9 C, 5.7 mm over 2.0 days >=0.1 mm
MeteoSwiss: highest temps July and August in lowlands; most intense heatwaves above 30 C typically June to August
MeteoSwiss: daily averages of 25 C or more possible at low altitude; Alpine thunderstorm clouds; more summer than winter precipitation in many places
Smartraveller Indonesia: wet season usually around October to April; heavy rain can flood roads in Bali (undated in 08-final; date added by edit)
BMKG Bali: June to August 2026 outlook 'Normal and Slightly Dry', 2026 only
Fiji Met Service Aug 2026: winter month, dry season; cool nights, windy periods, trade showers windward, leeward fine and drier
Fiji Aug 2026 extremes: 32.7 C Rarawai Mill (Ba), 9.8 C Nadarivatu; one month, not an average
NZ overview: July usually coldest, most snow in mountains, east and south of South Island may get snow
NZ Aug 2026: 9.7 C, +0.7 C vs 1991 to 2020; dry North Island, very wet west and south of South Island; one year
As at November 2026, Smartraveller NZ: ice, snow, fog on roads; snow chains or 4WD on mountain roads
Port Louis 1971 to 2000: min 19.1 C, max 26.8 C, 19.0 mm over 5.0 days >=1 mm; January max 31.5 C, 131.0 mm
As at November 2026, Smartraveller checklist: share itinerary, hard copies, subscribe to travel advice
FAQ: Port Louis 26.8 C and Fiji 'winter month and dry season' (source and year added by edit)
FAQ: 15 August public holiday in Italy
Advisor lines: confirms inclusions in writing; one Advisor start to finish, client time zone, quotes in AUD, fee agreed in writing
